document: B217_SENSE_BINDING_DECISION_AND_AUTHORIZATION (v2: authorization recorded 2026-10-25; binding registration approved, publication not approved)

proposed_binding.anchor_ku_id_field: Runtime ku_id of the kind=sense KU row

feasibility_basis: Runtime ku_ids are globally unique (16,617/16,617 verified in this delivery), so one anchor identifies exactly one row; no one-to-many ambiguity exists in the current Runtime.
Each of the six headwords has exactly one headword row (no duplicate-lemma rows), so ku_id cannot be cross-headword ambiguous for this batch.
All six anchors are kind=sense and playable, so the binding selects sense rows, not morphology/grammar/collocation rows.
Binding mints zero new identifiers, so it cannot collide with existing Runtime KU IDs or SRS keys; SRS data is untouched and its keys are unchanged.

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Duplicate attribution via shared gloss text
risks_and_mitigations.assessment: REAL if keyed by gloss: sibling rows share gloss text with different kinds (e.g. person ku02 morphology shares ku01 gloss). Mitigation (implemented in the QA script): binding keys ONLY on ku_id + kind=sense + rank/lemma/pos/gloss re-verification; gloss text alone never identifies a row.

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Future sense expansion / Runtime revision makes a binding stale
risks_and_mitigations.assessment: REAL. Mitigation: every binding pins runtime_sha256 and the exact Runtime gloss text; the fail-closed loader must re-verify SHA, ku_id, kind, and gloss on every load and reject on any drift. A new Runtime version requires re-review, never silent carryover.

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Multiple teaching packs referencing the same anchor
risks_and_mitigations.assessment: NOT a binding conflict: the binding is 1:1 between a sense and a KU row. Overlay builds must list each ku_id once; pack-level duplication is an overlay-build dedup rule, not a reason to mint a second sense identity.

risks_and_mitigations.risk: A future consumer requiring a sense_id field
risks_and_mitigations.assessment: OPEN. Such a consumer must consume the binding document's anchor_ku_id mapping; it must not invent an sNN value. If a sense_id field becomes mandatory, that is a registrar schema decision, not something QA can supply by renaming s01.

NO NEW RISK INTRODUCED: no identifier is added, removed, or renamed, so existing SRS keys are unaffected. This delivery performs zero SRS writes and the QA script asserts its inputs are unchanged after running.
